module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# $a(n) = \operatorname{lcm}\{1,2,\dots,n\}/\operatorname{denom}(H(n))$

*References:*
- [A110566](https://oeis.org/A110566)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace OeisA110566

open Nat Finset Rat

/--
The primary defining sequence `a`.
$a(n) = \frac{\operatorname{lcm}_{k=1}^n k}{\operatorname{den}(H_n)}$
-/
def a (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (Icc 1 n).lcm id / (harmonic n).den

/-- Term theorems verifying the first few values of the sequence against the official OEIS b-file -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_1 : a 1 = 1 := by simp [a]

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_2 : a 2 = 1 := by
  simp [a]
  decide

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_3 : a 3 = 1 := by
  simp [a]
  norm_num
  decide

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_4 : a 4 = 1 := by
  simp [a]
  norm_num
  decide

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_5 : a 5 = 1 := by
  simp [a]
  norm_num
  decide

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_6 : a 6 = 3 := by
  simp [a]
  norm_num
  decide


/--
It is conjectured that every odd number occurs in this sequence.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem conjecture :
  ∀ m : ℕ, Odd m → ∃ n > 0, a n = m := by
  sorry

end OeisA110566

review.notes: Checked all eight declarations: the sequence definition, six term tests, and conjecture. OEIS explicitly conjectures that every odd number occurs; A112822 confirms the intended positive-odd values. The Lean quantifiers and positive index restriction match. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, proved without sorry that harmonic n is the intended sum and its reduced denominator divides lcm{1,...,n}, so natural-number division gives the exact quotient. Checked the zero boundary (a 0 = 1, excluded by the conjecture) and matched all first 250 terms against the official b-file, including all six test theorems. The consulted source still labels the claim a conjecture, consistent with research open. Direct OEIS entry views were browser-challenged; their contents were read through the official oeis/oeisdata mirror.
